about: Two PlayStation®1 classics return: Fighting Force and Fighting Force 2!
Play the games like never before with

Fighting Force: Originally released in 1997, this beat 'em up classic let players become Hawk Manson, Mace Daniels, Alana McKendricks, or Ben "Smasher" Johnson as they fight to take down the evil Dr. Dex Zeng.
Choose from two male or two female characters, each with different skills and strengths.
Play alone or in co-op mode to defeat your enemies.
summary: Two PlayStation®1 classics return: Fighting Force and Fighting Force 2!
